newsitem.title: UK: Allied Domecq off as SocGen repeats "sell".
newsitem.headline: Allied Domecq off as SocGen repeats "sell".

text.p: Shares in Allied Domecq Plc dipped on Wednesday as analysts at SocGen repeated a "reduce" rating after a report of poor sales for its Teachers whisky brand yesterday.
The stock was down 1-1/2p at 442-1/2 by 0940 GMT, whereas the FTSE 100 index was up 27.8 points at 4,297.1.
"If you want to own a spirits stock then Allied is not the one to own," said SocGen analyst Steven Baird.
Data compiled by research group Stats MR and quoted by Highland Distilleries Plc showed sales of Teachers down sharply in the six months to December.
Sales by supermarkets and other retailers were down 28.6 percent and they were down 14 percent in the licensed trade.
Baird said Scottish & Newcastle Plc remained SocGen's favourite stock in the sector.
